about: A PERSON'S sign-off that releases a held key build from the freeze (links-04, Nov 4 2026; FINAL-v2 after Quality's grade, Nov 4 5:30 AM CST). One file per build: <build>.json = {"build": "US-<run id>", "verdict": "YES" | "NO", "by": "Brandon" | "KZ4CP", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC" (or ISO 8601 with a zone, or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM CST'), "note": "..."}. Only KPC_PERSONS (Brandon, KZ4CP) count, dated at or after the 9:37 AM CST Nov 2 2026 restart. A Quality note, a bot, old chat 11 text, a missing / unreadable / future date, or a date before the restart never unfreezes (a Quality or person NO still holds 2-fers on that build). Unfreezing never releases: the held answers are released only through data/waiting/approved.json in KPC-Data, by a person.
